§M{Inventory:overflow=unchecked}
  §U{System.Collections.Generic}

  §NS{_global:global}
    §M{Inventory:pub}
      §F{ParseOr:pub} (str:text, i32:fallback) -> i32
        §B{~n:i32} `default`
        §IF §C{int.TryParse} §A text §A{out} n §/C
          §R n
        §R fallback

      §F{CountOf:pub} (Dict<str, i32>:stock, str:item) -> i32
        §B{~count:i32} `default`
        §C{stock.TryGetValue} §A item §A{out} count §/C
        §R count

      §F{IsNumber:pub} (str:text) -> bool
        §R §C{int.TryParse} §A text §A{out} _ §/C

      §F{Bump:pub} (i32:x:ref)
        §ASSIGN x (+ x 1)

      §F{Twice:pub} (i32:x:in) -> i32
        §R (* x 2)

      §F{Run:pub} () -> i32
        §B{~total:i32} 1
        §C{Bump} §A{ref} total §/C
        §R (+ §C{Twice} §A{in} total §/C §C{ParseOr} §A "40" §A 0 §/C)
